x: The Aldershot pair Ford and Adams were reckoned to be certainities for medals but our own Bill Curtin, the reigning County Boys Champion, pushed them hard in the early stages, but he had to give way in the second mile as Ford proved invincible.
C.Pearson (27th) 18:45; J.Stow (20) 17:45; A.Black (24) 19:26; P.O'Connor (24) 18:00; L.Coy (25) 19:10; W.Weller (24) 18:29. Fastest of the day was B.Ford (Aldershot, F & D) 16:46.

It is doubted that we would even be in Division 2 if not for his work and encouragement. 1.B.Ford (Aldershot F & D) 26:43; 13.I.Duncan 29:07; 28.P.O'Connor 30:04; 29.S.Holmes 30:04; 37.D.Brown 30:41; 48.L.Coy 31:28; 59.
Now 47 Laurie seems to get faster as the years go by and took the vets prize 43 seconds ahead of Mike Barratt. 1.B.Ford, Ald.F & D. 23.05; 2.Gren Tuck, Camb. + C. 23.30.

It was pleasing to note that the local press generously acknowledged the unique achievement of 4 Bels making the Surrey Youths Inter-Counties Team and great to see Dave North's name alongside those of many illustreous past winners including that of Bernie Ford!

On this method of scoring he placed none other than our own Gerry North in top spot followed closely by Bernie Ford. Bernie has still a good few Nationals in him and no doubt he will take over top spot in the next year or so.
Add to that music supplied by the popular 'Jaguars' and with the equally popular Ann and Bernie Ford as principal guests you have the formula for success.
